title: The State of Independent Gym Websites 2026
note: Aggregates computed from automated scans. No individual site is identified.
attribution: Free to use and cite under CC BY 4.0. Credit Clikiti with a link.
citation: Clikiti. (2026, October 15). The state of independent gym websites 2026 (Q4 2026) [Report]. https://clikiti.com/research/gyms/2026-q4
audience: Web agencies and freelancers selling to independent gyms, CrossFit boxes, boxing and martial arts gyms and boutique studios
findings: Only 20% of the 165 independent gym and fitness studio websites we scanned say where to park or whether there is childcare.
A typical site answers four of the nine questions would-be members ask before choosing (mean 3.8).
The median overall score is 80 out of 100 (mean 79).
The least-answered questions are "Where do I park, and can I bring my kids?" (20%), "Who will coach me, and are they qualified?" (29%) and "Do other members vouch for it?" (31%).
The best-answered are "Can I try it first?" (67%) and "What does it cost to join?" (64%).
By kind of business, the highest median score is 80 (independent gyms), against 80 for boutique studios, 79 for CrossFit and functional fitness and 78 for boxing and martial arts.
94% fail "Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone" (Core Web Vitals · LCP).
79% fail "ExerciseGym, HealthClub or SportsActivityLocation structured data" (Schema.org · ExerciseGym).

ExerciseGym, HealthClub or SportsActivityLocation structured data

agencyProblems.label: Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone
agencyProblems.fix: Resize and compress the hero image and the class videos, defer the booking widget, aim for under 2.5 s on a phone.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your home page takes several seconds to appear on a phone in the car park.

agencyProblems.label: Parking or childcare stated
agencyProblems.question: Where do I park, and can I bring my kids?
agencyProblems.fix: One line on parking and one on childcare (or that there is none), on the contact or first-visit page.
agencyProblems.pitch: Parents and drivers want to know two practical things before the first class, and your site answers neither.

agencyProblems.label: ExerciseGym, HealthClub or SportsActivityLocation structured data
agencyProblems.fix: Add ExerciseGym, HealthClub or SportsActivityLocation structured data with the address, phone and opening hours.
agencyProblems.pitch: Search engines and assistants have to guess where you are and when you are open.

agencyProblems.label: Text contrast passes 4.5:1
agencyProblems.fix: Raise text contrast to at least 4.5:1 in the theme, including text set over photographs.
agencyProblems.pitch: Grey text on dark photographs is hard to read, and it is a WCAG failure.

agencyProblems.label: Coaches named, with their certifications
agencyProblems.question: Who will coach me, and are they qualified?
agencyProblems.fix: A coaches page with each coach named, a photograph and the certifications they hold (CrossFit Level 2, NASM, belt rank, RYT 200, a Pilates certification).
agencyProblems.pitch: Your coaches are qualified, and the site never says so. A first-timer wants to know who will be in the room.
